provenance: H-201 spec Method, inherited VERBATIM from H-160's registration freeze: 'the jargon list for the gloss lint (preflight, assertion, fixture, counted run, calibration, fragment, verdict, on-keep)'. Terms and rules byte-equivalent to H-160's; only this provenance line names the successor.
rule: Each listed term, at its FIRST occurrence in the page's prose (pointer spans and quoted artifact spans excluded), must be immediately followed by a parenthetical gloss of at least ten characters that opens and closes on the same line: term(s?) (gloss...). Terms that never occur in prose pass vacuously. Matching is case-insensitive; an optional plural 's' on the term is part of the first occurrence.
bare_slug_rule: Slug pattern [HD]-\d{3}: the FIRST occurrence of each distinct slug in prose (pointer spans and quoted spans excluded) must be immediately followed by ' (' and a gloss of at least ten characters closing on the same line, or by ' — ' and prose. Later occurrences may be bare. Zero unglossed first uses = zero bare slugs.
